# durantic_vip (Data Source)

Looks up a Durantic VIP (virtual IP) by UUID or name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Copyright (c) HashiCorp, Inc.

# Look up a VIP by name.
data "durantic_vip" "web" {
  name = "web-vip"
}

# VIPs can also be looked up by UUID.
data "durantic_vip" "by_uuid" {
  uuid = "a8ecf9c8-1721-424d-ba0f-87917dfc03d8"
}

# Attach an existing VIP to a machine role.
resource "durantic_machine_role" "web" {
  name     = "web"
  vip_uuid = data.durantic_vip.web.uuid
}

output "web_vip_address" {
  value = data.durantic_vip.web.address
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `name` (String) Name of the VIP. Set either `uuid` or `name`.
- `uuid` (String) Unique identifier for the VIP. Set either `uuid` or `name`.

### Read-Only

- `address` (String) IP address of the VIP.
- `created_at` (String) Timestamp when the VIP was created.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the VIP is enabled.
- `health_check_healthy_threshold` (Number) Consecutive successful checks before a machine is considered healthy.
- `health_check_holdoff_seconds` (Number) Seconds to wait after startup before health checks begin counting.
- `health_check_interval_seconds` (Number) Interval in seconds between health checks.
- `health_check_target` (String) Health check target (path or command depending on type).
- `health_check_timeout_seconds` (Number) Timeout in seconds for a single health check.
- `health_check_type` (String) Health check type (`""` when disabled, otherwise e.g. `tcp`, `http`, `https`, `grpc`, `grpcs`).
- `health_check_unhealthy_threshold` (Number) Consecutive failed checks before a machine is considered unhealthy.
- `machine_count` (Number) Number of machines the VIP is assigned to.
- `machine_uuids` (List of String) UUIDs of the machines the VIP is assigned to.
- `updated_at` (String) Timestamp when the VIP was last updated.
